title: Air Conditioning — Air Cycle Machine — Silencer and Decoupled Mount Retrofit
abstract: Retrofit of the tuned air cycle machine silencer, the re-routed hose and the decoupled mount, offered to operators of high-density cabins who want the rear-row acoustic improvement without waiting for a pack change.

sections.planning_reason: Cabin comfort surveys on high-density layouts identified a persistent tonal component at 3.2 kilohertz in the last six seat rows, measured at 8 dB above the broadband level and traced to the second-stage turbine of the air cycle machine. It is not a defect and drives no maintenance action, but for operators competing on cabin comfort it is the single largest contributor to the rear-cabin score. Aircraft delivered before the production cut-in do not have the tuned silencer.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the turbine outlet silencer with a tuned item of longer expansion volume, re-routes the machine hose with a longer radius to move its first structural mode away from the offending frequency, changes the bypass restrictor to hold the machine below the tonal speed band in cruise, and replaces the mount foot washer with a bonded elastomeric item that decouples the casing from the pack bay structure.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the belly fairing panels and get access to the pack bay in zones 191 and 192. Isolate the bleed supply and depressurise the pack. Remove the existing silencer and install the accumulator item KEDE723823-59 with a new seal. Remove the machine hose LU579123-82 and install it on the longer radius clip set supplied in the kit. Replace the bypass restrictor D2150113216257 and set it to the datum given in the accomplishment instructions. Replace the mount foot washer EN911564K9 with the bonded elastomeric item and torque in the sequence given. Re-clip the pipe of FIN 4HM clear of the new silencer body. Restore the bleed supply and do the pack operational test. Do a cabin noise survey at cruise on the next revenue sector and report the result. Close the belly fairing and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft with the high-density cabin arrangement that are not yet at the tuned silencer standard. Aircraft delivered after the production cut-in already have it. The bulletin has no effect on ZEPHYR-18 or ZEPHYR-20 aircraft, whose pack bay geometry gives a different acoustic result.
sections.material_note: Kit K2150-1194-01 contains the silencer, the clip set, the restrictor and the elastomeric washer for one pack. Two kits are required per aircraft. Lead time is ten weeks. Most operators order one kit at a time and embody at pack overhaul rather than as a campaign.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, normally at the next pack overhaul.
